title: The Effect of Satureja Hortensis L .Leaf Powder on Pain and Pro inflammatory Cytokines (TNF-α , IL-1β) in Patients with Knee Osteoarthritis
index_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the influence of leaf powder savory pain and pro-inflammatory cytokines in patients with osteoarthritis of the knee. This study is a double-blind, placebo-controlled study in phase I clinical trials. The study population of patients with knee osteoarthritis are 40 to 70 years. The main inclusion criteria included individuals between the ages of 40 to 70 years; Knee osteoarthritis is diagnosed according to American College of Rheumatology.The main exclusion criteria included: patients less than 80% capsules are consumed; Patients who have inflammatory diseases, metabolic (diabetes), cancer, liver and kidney failure. Intervention in this study is daily consumption of 3 capsules dried savory leaves or 3 placebo capsules. Intervening period is between 23/09/2013 to 03/03/2014. In this study Pain, IL 1 beta and TNF-alpha will be measured.
